abilities.name: Rites of Tempering
abilities.description: Attacks that target this unit with a S greater than this unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.

abilities.name: Iron Father
abilities.description: While this model is within 3" of a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit, this model has Lone Operative.

abilities.name: Master of the Forge
abilities.description:
In your Movement phase, at the start or end of this unit’s move, you can select one friendly Adeptus Astartes Vehicle model within 3" of this model:


- That Vehicle model heals 3 wounds.
- That Vehicle model’s attacks can ignore modifiers to the following until the start of your next Movement phase:
- BS.
- Hit rolls and wound rolls.

abilities.name: Leader
abilities.description:
This model can be attached to the following units:
AGGRESSOR SQUAD, ERADICATOR SQUAD WITH HEAVY BOLTERS, ERADICATOR SQUAD WITH MELTA RIFLES, HEAVY INTERCESSOR SQUAD

abilities.name: Cold and Calculating
abilities.description:
In your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when this unit is selected to attack, you can select one of the following for this unit’s attacks to have:


- [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle].
- Or: [Sustained Hits 1: non-[Monster/Vehicle]
- Or: If the tactical doctrine is active for this unit, [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle] and [Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/Vehicle]

abilities.name: Cerebrex Logic Engine
abilities.description: In the Declare Battle Formations step, you can select one friendly **Adeptus Astartes Infantry** unit. That unit has Scouts 6".

This model can be attached to the following units:
